articles.title: Spotify Reveals Massive Spike in Streams for Music Featured in GTA 6
articles.summary: Spotify has released new data that shows huge spikes in streams for music featured in GTA 6, including a Carly Rae Jepsen song from over a decade ago. In an email sent to IGN, Spotify revealed that the GTA 6 hype is inspiring listeners to add tons of music from the game to their playlists.
body: Additionally, fans are listening to the official GTA 6 playlist en masse and are actively searching for things related to the game. You can view the full breakdown courtesy of Spotify below.

GTA 6 has been shattering all kinds of records and setting new trends. The game had the biggest launch in the history of PlayStation and sold nearly $4 billion worth of copies in its first 24 hours, making it the highest-grossing entertainment launch of all time by a significant margin. The game has also set viewership records on platforms like Twitch, led to a massive increase in internet traffic, and so much more.

It's a massive cultural moment that's likely not going to end anytime soon. Not only will this game likely get bigger, but it also has more big events on the horizon. It's also expected to release on PC early next year, and an online mode is also heavily speculated to come in the future.

articles.title: Three Years After His Death, EA Is Using AI To Bring Back A Famed Commentator In FC 27
articles.summary: EA Sports FC 27 is adding an AI-generated commentator for the first time in the series' history, with famed British commentator John Motson having his voice synthesized for the football title.
body: Motson, who passed way in 2023, previously provided commentary for EA's FIFA series, appearing in the game's first iteration in 1996 and featuring until 2005. According to the BBC, EA approached Motson's wife and son for permission to regenerate his voice and use his likeness for this year's entry in the series. Both agreed to the idea, but neither party has disclosed how much EA has paid for the use. Fred Motson, John's son, stated that he believed his father would've approved of this use of AI.

"My dad was the least technological person in the world," Fred stated. "Till his dying day, he had a typewriter on his desk. So I don't think he would have quite understood what the AI was doing technologically, but I think, on the other hand, he was always really keen to get involved in these kinds of projects."

articles.title: Sunrise on the Reaping Director Reveals That Every Hunger Games Movie Has Initially Been Rated R
articles.summary: Longtime director of The Hunger Games franchise Francis Lawrence has revealed that all five films he has directed in the series were initially rated R and opened up about the process of making them PG-13.
body: On paper, The Hunger Games franchise is tonally very interesting. Although it's a young adult novel series, targeting teenagers, it's about children being forced to fight to the death in a dystopian society. The books don't hold back on the violence, and the films have always had to walk a fine line so they can reach the widest audience possible. The process of making the movies PG-13 is complicated and often inconsistent.

When speaking with Kevin McCarthy, director Francis Lawrence noted that all five of the Hunger Games films he has worked on were initially rated R. The director noted that across his whole career, he has run into an issue of making a movie with a PG-13 rating in mind, but the MPA (Motion Picture Association) reserves the right to give it an R if it's too "intense," even if there's no excessive blood, gore, language, or nudity. It happened with Constantine, it was a concern with I Am Legend, and it has happened regularly with The Hunger Games series.

articles.title: Diablo 4’s Most Nostalgic Season Is Becoming (Mostly) Permanent
articles.summary: Diablo 4 is gearing up for the arrival of Season 16, but it won't be leaving its popular previous season behind entirely. As detailed by Blizzard in a breakdown of the upcoming Season of Tyrael's Gambit, much of the previous season, Hell's Legacy, will become a permanent part of Diablo 4 going…
body: Most of that is carrying forward, Blizzard said. Due to "overwhelming requests" from the game's community, Blizzard outlined what all from Hell's Legacy will survive.

Hell's Legacy's capstone dungeons will be added, as will the ability to summon a World Boss version of Diablo and take on the cow god Moopisto. The Prime Evil Council is also becoming permanent, and will work the same way the game's other Lair bosses do, with players needing a specific item to open their reward chest after successfully defeating the encounter.

Waking Nightmare dungeons will still be accessible, but only by finding Chronicle of Nightmares dungeon keys. Monsters from previous Diablo games will also have a chance to spawn in The Pit. Those who progressed their secret cow level journey can also rejoice, as the secret cow island and its corresponding waypoint will be staying.

Many of Hell's Legacy's best items were new versions of classics from older Diablo games, and those Legacy Uniques will be added permanently as well, including the Annihilus Seal and Hellfire Torch Charm.

articles.title: How to get adrenaline in GTA 6
articles.summary: Adrenaline acts as an emergency boost to all your stats in Grand Theft Auto 6, as it temporarily negates health, stamina, and focus loss. It's meant to get you out of an emergency situation safely or help you burst into a tense situation and mop it up fast.
body: This is not to be confused with the other robbery opportunities that have green markers or stick ups that have gray markers. These areas can have adrenaline, but they're a bit rarer.

There's also a chance to find adrenaline in the back of ambulances, either loose or in a trauma kit. Getting it this way is pretty tough until you reach Chapter 3 and can explore Vice City more freely, though. The city hospital always has a few ambulances around back in the parking lot. They aren't very well attended, so you can break in with comparative ease. They are alarmed, so make sure to slim jim the door first, and then open the back to avoid setting off the alarm.

You might see ambulances driving along the roads of Leonida or the streets of Vice City. If you're really desperate for adrenaline, you can stop them and break into the back. This is a pretty big and unnecessary risk to take if you're trying to keep a low profile, though.

articles.title: Why GTA 6 Doesn’t Let You Replay Missions–It Felt “Alien And Disconnected”
articles.summary: One of the first things people noticed with Grand Theft Auto 6 is that you cannot replay missions, at least not in a simple, straightforward way. GTA 5 had a mission replay option, as did Red Dead Redemption II, so why doesn't GTA 6?
body: Senior design director Scott Butchard told Kotaku that Rockstar "certainly" considered a mission replay feature "early on in development." However, Butchard said, "As the game came together, it felt at odds with the story we were trying to tell and felt a bit alien and disconnected."
He went on to say replaying missions "really diminished the choices you had made."

While GTA 6 doesn't make it easy to replay missions, you still can do so by reloading an earlier GTA 6 save. Something else to know is that if you're in the middle of a mission and it's not going to plan, you can open the game menu and select retry, quit, or restart.

GTA 6 blasted off with 32.5 million sales via prepurchases alone and around $4 billion in revenue on day one. The game is only going to get bigger and sell more copies over time, and it's helping drive new PlayStation and Xbox hardware sales.

articles.title: Capcom Is Officially Killing Its 'Jurassic World Meets Overwatch' Shooter
articles.summary: Four years after the game's launch, Capcom is officially shutting down Exoprimal, the company's 5v5 action game about a futuristic dinosaur crisis. Capcom announced Tuesday that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued in September 2027 — meaning that Exoprimal will no longer be playable — and…
body: While disappointing for stalwart Exoprimal fans, the writing has been on the wall since 2024, when Capcom all but confirmed the sci-fi action game's grim fate.

In an official notice posted to the Exoprimal website, Capcom confirms that players will lose access to the game next year. "We regret to announce that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued as of 8:00 PM (PDT) on Wednesday, September 29, 2027," the shutdown announcement reads. "We cannot thank you enough for the love and support you have shown over the years, and we sincerely apologize for the gravity of this announcement."

Capcom has already pulled the game's four seasonal Survival Passes from stores, and warns that Exoprimal, its DLC, and all related products will no longer be sold on digital stores as of March 30, 2027. The game will shut down completely on Sept. 29, 2027, as Exoprimal is first and foremost a team-based competitive multiplayer game. Capcom notes that it will still be possible to download the game after Exoprimal is removed from stores.

articles.title: The Fable reboot had to look beyond Lionhead's RPG trilogy because games like The Witcher 3 "became the gold standard"
articles.summary: Developer Playground Games had to look beyond Lionhead's original run of Fable games when rebooting the classic fantasy series, and it's all thanks to games like The Witcher 3, which changed what many players expect from their big RPGs and set a new "gold standard."
body: The upcoming Fable reboot is finally ending its decade-long development journey soon. Playground Games had to set up an entirely new team to work on its fairytale revival, so Fable's production wasn't quite as smooth sailing as the studio's consistently excellent Forza Horizon series, for example.

Asked about what's changed during that time, in an interview with GamesIndustry.biz, studio founder and general manager Ralph Fulton named technological advancements as a biggie, but the impact of other games was perhaps even greater.

"In 2015, The Witcher 3 redefined what an open-world action RPG looks like and became the gold standard," Fulton said. "And after that bar was raised, the Assassin's Creed franchise changed into this more modern iteration with Origins, Odyssey, and Valhalla, and became like a quasi-RPG."

"All of these games continue to reset player expectations," he continued. Millions of players suddenly had certain expectations about what their big-budget, open-world role-playing games should look like. So, Playground couldn't pull inspiration from Fable and Fable alone.

articles.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Is Making Sure Patrick Stewart Gets a Proper Sendoff
articles.summary: Patrick Stewart's final on-screen performance will arrive in December's Avengers: Doomsday, and Marvel is making sure the late actor receives a fitting farewell.
body: Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige and directors Anthony and Joe Russo are planning to include a tribute to Stewart in the upcoming superhero blockbuster, according to a new interview with Variety. Stewart died on Oct. 29 at age 86 following a brief battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy Body Dementia.

The actor had already completed filming for Doomsday, in which he reprises his iconic role as Professor Charles Xavier for the ninth and final time. Speaking to Variety, Feige revealed that Stewart's last day on set was an emotional occasion, with the actor delivering a speech to the crew.
"He stood up and he gave a speech to the crew," Feige said. "We didn't know necessarily it would be his last day on a set, but he was sort of indicating to us that he thought it was."
Anthony Russo also recalled how difficult filming had become for Stewart as he struggled with his health. Despite the challenges, the actor remained committed to delivering his performance.

articles.title: EA is resurrecting a dead commentator with AI for EA Sports FC 27, years after his last appearance in a FIFA game
articles.summary: EA Sports FC 27 is using gen-AI to digitally recreate the voice of veteran football commentator John Motson - the FIFA video game series' first ever real-world announcer who died in 2023.
body: John Motson commentated on hundreds of football games over the course of five different decades, starting in the 1970s. The English commentator then became the mainstay voice of EA's dominant football simulation series, beginning with FIFA 96 all the way up until FIFA 2005, when the publisher decided to go in a different direction.

But EA's now decided to digitally resurrect Motson - or, at least, his incredibly recognisable voice - with permission from his family. An update with Motson's voice will go live on 26th November. "There was no way we would have moved forward with this in any way, shape or form if they weren't fully on board," senior game designer director Mat Prior said in a statement given to the BBC earlier today.

articles.title: GTA 6 has weird purple streetlights because actual Florida screwed up its streetlights
articles.summary: When you're exploring a world as realistic and well-observed as GTA 6's Leonida, it's rare for a piece of benign infrastructure to stick out. But on night one of my playthrough, I clocked some weird streetlights. Why are some of them turquoise? And hey, why are these purple?
body: A stylistic choice by Rockstar? Maybe, but it's awfully specific, and I had a feeling there was a deeper intention behind it. So I DMed my buddy Henry, an honest-to-god Floridian who was also playing GTA 6, and asked what's up. At first he thought strange streetlights in the Key Lento area of the map were special lights meant to not disorient turtles, but those are typically red, so probably not. And that doesn't explain the purple ones.
So Henry reached out to friends in south Florida, the region that Leonida's biggest cities are based on, and they cracked the case wide open.

"The purple [lights] are definitely real. We have a ton of them down here because whoever is in charge of that in the government bought a bunch of defective lights," the anonymous Floridian responded.

Yes, actual Florida cities are lit by these dubiously dim, yet undeniably cool purple lamps. According to ClickOrlando, residents first started reporting the purple streetlights in 2023. They put up hundreds of these things across the state before they started malfunctioning—it was such a kerfuffle that the government eventually released a statement saying their vendor really screwed the pooch.
